```python
# Generated by Selenium IDE / Automated Test Suite
import pytest
import time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

class TestLogin:
    def setup_method(self, method):
        self.driver = webdriver.Chrome()
        self.driver.maximize_window()  # Maximize window to prevent hidden elements
        self.wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10)  # Explicit wait

    def teardown_method(self, method):
        self.driver.quit()

    def test_login(self):
        # Navigate to MediTwin AI login portal
        self.driver.get("http://localhost:3000/login")
        
        # Wait for email field to appear and enter registered email
        email_field = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME, "email"))

        email_field.send_keys("doctor.rohith@meditwin.local")
        
        # Wait for password field to appear and enter password
        password_field = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME, "password"))
        )
        password_field.send_keys("DoctorPass@123")
        
        # Wait for login button and click it
        login_btn = self.wait.until(
            EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button[type='submit']"))
        )
        login_btn.click()
        
        # Verify successful login and navigation to dashboard
```

## Test Case 2: Registration test of already existing user

### Code
```python
# Generated by Selenium IDE / Automated Test Suite
import pytest
import time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

class TestRegistrationExistingUser:
    def setup_method(self, method):
        self.driver = webdriver.Chrome()
        self.driver.maximize_window()
        self.wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10)

    def teardown_method(self, method):
        self.driver.quit()

    def test_registration_already_existing(self):
        # 1. Navigate to the registration page
        self.driver.get("http://localhost:3000/register")

        # 2. Valid full name entered
        name_field = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME, "fullName"))
        )
        name_field.clear()
        name_field.send_keys("Dr. Sarah Jenkins")

        # 3. Valid date of birth entered
        dob_field = self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "dob")
        dob_field.send_keys("1995-06-15")

        # 4. Valid gender selected
        gender_select = self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "gender")
        gender_select.send_keys("Female")

        # 5. Valid blood group selected
        blood_select = self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "bloodGroup")
        blood_select.send_keys("O+")

        # 6. Valid phone number entered
        phone_field = self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "phone")
        phone_field.clear()
        phone_field.send_keys("9876543210")

        # 7. Enter already registered email id
        email_field = self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "email")
        email_field.clear()
        email_field.send_keys("sarah.jenkins@meditwin.local")

        # 8. Enter username
        username_field = self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "username")
        username_field.clear()
        username_field.send_keys("sarah_jenkins")

        # 9. Valid password entered
        password_field = self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "password")
        password_field.clear()
        password_field.send_keys("SecurePass@123")

        # 10. Re-entered the same password for confirmation
        confirm_field = self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "confirmPassword")
        confirm_field.clear()
        confirm_field.send_keys("SecurePass@123")

        # 11. Agree to terms and conditions
        terms_checkbox = self.driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[name='agreeTerms'], input[type='checkbox']")
        if not terms_checkbox.is_selected():
            terms_checkbox.click()

        # 12. Click on submit button
        submit_btn = self.wait.until(
            EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button[type='submit']"))
        )
        submit_btn.click()

        # 13. System validates duplicate check with database and displays error alert
        error_banner = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//*[contains(text(), 'already exists') or contains(text(), 'already registered')]"))
        )
        assert error_banner.is_displayed(), "System failed to show error message for duplicate email registration."
        assert "/register" in self.driver.current_url
        time.sleep(2)
```

## Test Case 3: Load test what if 1000 patients login at same time

### Code
```python
# Automated Concurrency & Load Test Suite
import time
import pytest
import concurrent.futures
import requests

BACKEND_URL = "http://localhost:5000/api/auth/login"

class TestPatientLoginLoad:
    def send_login_request(self, user_index):
        payload = {
            "email": f"patient.test_{user_index % 50}@meditwin.local",
            "password": "PatientPass@123"
        }
        start_time = time.time()
        try:
            # Send concurrent HTTP authentication request
            response = requests.post(BACKEND_URL, json=payload, timeout=8)
            duration_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
            return {
                "user_index": user_index,
                "status_code": response.status_code,
                "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "success": response.status_code in [200, 401]
            }
        except Exception as e:
            return {"user_index": user_index, "status_code": 0, "success": False, "error": str(e)}

    def test_load_1000_concurrent_patients(self):
        total_virtual_users = 1000
        concurrency_workers = 100  # 100 concurrent thread pool workers

        start_overall = time.time()
        results = []
        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=concurrency_workers) as executor:
            futures = [executor.submit(self.send_login_request, i) for i in range(total_virtual_users)]
            for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
                results.append(future.result())

        total_time = time.time() - start_overall
        successful_requests = [r for r in results if r["success"]]
        durations = [r["duration_ms"] for r in successful_requests]
        avg_latency = sum(durations) / len(durations) if durations else 0
        error_rate = ((total_virtual_users - len(successful_requests)) / total_virtual_users) * 100

        # Assertions for Load SLA
        assert len(successful_requests) == 1000, f"Expected 1000 successful logins, got {len(successful_requests)}"
        assert error_rate == 0.0, f"Error rate exceeded threshold: {error_rate}%"
        assert avg_latency < 2000, f"Average latency SLA violated (>2000ms): {avg_latency:.1f}ms"
```

## Test Case 4: Authentication test

### Code
```python
# Generated by Selenium IDE / Automated Test Suite
import pytest
import time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

class TestAuthentication:
    def setup_method(self, method):
        self.driver = webdriver.Chrome()
        self.driver.maximize_window()
        self.wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10)

    def teardown_method(self, method):
        self.driver.quit()

    def test_authentication_security(self):
        # 1. Test Valid Credentials Authentication
        self.driver.get("http://localhost:3000/login")
        self.wait.until(EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME, "email"))).send_keys("doctor.rohith@meditwin.local")
        self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "password").send_keys("DoctorPass@123")
        self.driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button[type='submit']").click()

        # Verify authentication generates token and authorizes dashboard
        self.wait.until(EC.url_contains("/dashboard/doctor"))
        token = self.driver.execute_script("return localStorage.getItem('token') || sessionStorage.getItem('token');")
        assert token is not None and len(token) > 20, "JWT session token was not created."

        # 2. Test Invalid Password Rejection
        self.driver.get("http://localhost:3000/login")
        self.wait.until(EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.NAME, "email"))).send_keys("doctor.rohith@meditwin.local")
        self.driver.find_element(By.NAME, "password").send_keys("WrongInvalidPassword@999")
        self.driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button[type='submit']").click()

        auth_error = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//*[contains(text(), 'Invalid credentials')]"))
        )
        assert auth_error.is_displayed(), "System failed to deny login on invalid password."
        assert "/dashboard" not in self.driver.current_url

        # 3. Test Direct Protected Route Access without Token
        self.driver.execute_script("localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear();")
        self.driver.get("http://localhost:3000/dashboard/doctor")
        self.wait.until(lambda d: "/login" in d.current_url or "Sign In" in d.page_source)
        assert "/login" in self.driver.current_url, "Unauthenticated visitor bypassed security guard."
```

## Test Case 5: Patient Prescriptions & Medication Management Test

### Code
```python
# Generated by Selenium IDE / Automated Test Suite
import pytest
import time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

class TestPatientPrescriptions:
    def setup_method(self, method):
        self.driver = webdriver.Chrome()
        self.driver.maximize_window()
        self.wait = WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10)

    def teardown_method(self, method):
        self.driver.quit()

    def test_patient_prescriptions_management(self):
        # 1. Navigate to MediTwin AI login portal
        self.driver.get("http://localhost:3000/login")

        # 2. Enter registered patient credentials
        email_field = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[type='email'], input[name='email']"))
        )
        email_field.clear()
        email_field.send_keys("patient.test@meditwin.local")

        password_field = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[type='password'], input[name='password']"))
        )
        password_field.clear()
        password_field.send_keys("PatientPass@123")

        # 3. Submit login authentication form
        login_btn = self.wait.until(
            EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button[type='submit']"))
        )
        login_btn.click()

        # 4. Verify successful authentication and load Patient Health Dashboard
        self.wait.until(EC.url_contains("/dashboard/patient"))

        # 5. Navigate to My Prescriptions module
        prescriptions_tab = self.wait.until(
            EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, "//nav//button[contains(., 'Prescriptions')]"))
        )
        prescriptions_tab.click()

        # 6. Verify My Prescriptions header and clinical notice are rendered
        rx_header = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//h2[contains(text(), 'My Prescriptions')]"))
        )
        assert rx_header.is_displayed(), "My Prescriptions page failed to load."

        # 7. Search for prescribed medication (e.g., Amlodipine)
        search_box = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[placeholder*='Search medicine']"))
        )
        search_box.clear()
        search_box.send_keys("Amlodipine")

        # 8. Assert matching prescription card is displayed with dosage & frequency
        med_card = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//*[contains(text(), 'Amlodipine') or contains(text(), 'AmLODIPine')]"))
        )
        assert med_card.is_displayed(), "Prescription search result for Amlodipine was not found."

        dosage_badge = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//*[contains(text(), '5 mg')]"))
        )
        assert dosage_badge.is_displayed(), "Medication dosage badge (5 mg) is missing."

        # 9. Click Details button to inspect the official Clinical Prescription Modal
        details_btn = self.wait.until(
            EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.XPATH, "//button[contains(., 'Details')]"))
        )
        details_btn.click()

        # 10. Verify Clinical Prescription Modal displays verified physician instructions
        modal_instructions = self.wait.until(
            EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//*[contains(text(), 'Special Instructions')]"))
        )
        assert modal_instructions.is_displayed(), "Prescription Details modal failed to open."

        time.sleep(1)
```
